cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Take My Side
cards.instruction: Recruit someone into your interpretation of a conflict involving a shared relationship.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. You're Alex's friend too. Tell him alternating weekends at the allotment was a fair compromise.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We agreed all three of us would go every Saturday.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Then help him see my version as sharing the workload.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll talk to him, but you have to admit you changed it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I will. Could you explain that I changed the rota because I want us to stay friends?

mechanism: A uses its pupil fairness and apology lessons to recruit a shared friend into the charitable interpretation of A unilateral rota change.
confusable: Not neutral mediation: the concession of fault is framed to preserve A preferred motive.
comparison: Family narration versus friend-group scheduling dispute.
